Intake note (Commercial team, 9 August 2025). Our client Sunanda Banerjee is a 52-year-old civil engineer who lives at Bungalow 16, Satellite, Ahmedabad 380042 and can be reached on 99799 83871 or sunanda.banerjee@example.in. The client's PAN DFMPB3367U.
The client consulted us about a breach of contract matter (Project Pelican) against M/s Lotus Industries. The breach of contract claim against M/s Lotus Industries is for ₹3.5 crore; the counterparty has not paid the invoices for delivered goods.
The matter was filed as Com. S. No. 2624/2025 before the Ahmedabad Commercial Court on 31 August 2025.
